epic.title: Parent Transport & Fleet Tracking Module
epic.body: Provides parents with real-time visibility into school bus locations, route details, driver information, and estimated arrival times for multiple children to ensure safety and convenience.

features.title: Real-time Bus Tracking
features.body: Enables parents to track the live location of their child's school bus on a map, including speed, direction, and stop sequence.

stories.title: Interactive Fleet Tracking Interface
stories.body: Implement a map-based UI showing the live position of the bus assigned to the selected child.
acceptanceCriteria: Map: Display a live marker for the school bus with directional icons.
Routes: Visualize the polyline representing the assigned route path.
Stops: Mark 'Pickup' and 'Drop-off' points on the map with distinct icons.
Context: Automatically update the bus tracking view when switching between child profiles on the dashboard.

stories.title: Live GPS Coordinate Provider
stories.body: API service to stream or fetch real-time GPS coordinates for buses assigned to a parent's children.
acceptanceCriteria: Get: Endpoint to retrieve current latitude/longitude and speed for a specific busId.
Security: Restrict tracking access to parents whose children are assigned to that specific route/bus.
History: Provide estimated time of arrival (ETA) based on the current bus position and the child's stop.

features.title: Route & Driver Information
features.body: Access to detailed information regarding the child's transport assignment, including driver contact and vehicle details.

stories.title: Transport Details & Contact Interface
stories.body: As a parent, I want to see information about the bus number, route name, and driver contact details.
acceptanceCriteria: Display: Show cards containing Bus Number, Route Name (e.g., 'Route 42 - Downtown'), and Driver Name.
Interactions: Click-to-call functionality for the driver's mobile number.
Vehicle Info: Display vehicle model and registration number for identification.

stories.title: Bus & Driver Data Service
stories.body: API endpoints to retrieve the relationship between students, routes, vehicles, and drivers.
acceptanceCriteria: List: GET endpoint to retrieve transport assignment for a specific studentId.
Mapping: Return combined object including route sequence, vehicle details, and driver profile.
Update: Ensure any change in driver assignment in the admin panel reflects immediately for the parent.

features.title: Safety & Proximity Notifications
features.body: Automated alerts for parents based on bus proximity to the pickup/drop-off point and emergency incidents.

stories.title: Transport Alert & Incident Log
stories.body: Interface to view a chronological log of transport-related notifications like 'Bus nearing stop' or 'Delayed due to traffic'.
acceptanceCriteria: Log: Display a timeline of alerts including timestamp and category (Proximity, Delay, Emergency).
Dashboard Integration: Show a high-level transport status badge (e.g., 'On Time', 'Delayed') on the child profile.

stories.title: Geofencing & Alert Trigger Service
stories.body: Backend logic to process bus proximity to stops and trigger relevant notifications to parents.
acceptanceCriteria: Logic: Detect when a bus enters a 500m geofence around a student's stop.
CRUD: POST/GET endpoints to manage and retrieve alert history for a parent.
Incident: API to handle emergency incident logs reported by drivers and notify affected parents.
